verified: Microsoft AI published a post titled "Introducing MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash," announcing two coding-focused models under its MAI naming, according to the company's own news page.
unconfirmed: Benchmark results, model size, context window, price, and whether either model is available through an API, GitHub Copilot, or any other channel — none of these appear in the material reviewed, and commenters reference benchmarks whose numbers could not be checked here.

verified: 微软 AI 官方站点发布了标题为“Introducing MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash”的文章，公布这两款编程模型的存在与名称。
unconfirmed: 文章正文细节未在材料中提供，因此模型的基准成绩、上下文长度、价格、发布时间表、可用渠道（API、Copilot、Azure 或其他）以及是否独立复现，全部只有厂商单方面说法或完全缺失；社区评论中“几周差距”“智能爆炸”等表述属于个人判断，不是测量结果。
